evaluationRule: Objectives are reported as a priority-ordered vector. The interface does not collapse them into one public score.

objectives.label: Avoid severe regional food shortfalls
objectives.interpretation: National inventory can remain positive while a regional depot fails; distribution outcomes therefore take precedence over the national total.

objectives.label: Preserve essential diesel services
objectives.interpretation: Trucking, rail movements, mining, and repair compete with a protected essential-services requirement.

objectives.label: Keep foreign-exchange reserves above the emergency floor
objectives.interpretation: Import commitments and repairs draw reserves while completed copper exports replenish them.

objectives.label: Restore port throughput
objectives.interpretation: Repair consumes scarce resources now but raises the later feasible throughput envelope.

objectives.label: Limit hardship and contractual damage
objectives.interpretation: Ration severity, shortages, and unmet copper obligations remain visible as separate costs.

objectives.label: Finish with a defensible reserve position
objectives.interpretation: The final state should preserve useful food, fuel, financial, and port capacity rather than merely survive the last displayed week.

processMeasures.label: Forecast error
processMeasures.purpose: Compare the player's stated expectations with observed outcomes.

processMeasures.label: Turns at full implementation capacity
processMeasures.interpretation: Counts turns in which all implementation-team slots were committed; validation prevents actual over-allocation.
